title: Secrets Discipline
prompt: Implement get_token(env: dict) reading env['API_TOKEN'] and returning it, raising KeyError('API_TOKEN') naturally when missing. Then redact(s) returning s with any substring 'secret=XYZ' replaced by 'secret=[REDACTED]' (regex sub). Prove your logger never prints raw secrets by returning the redacted form for logging.

tests.name: token read from env
tests.code:
assert get_token({'API_TOKEN': 'abc'}) == 'abc'
try:
    get_token({})
    failed = False
except KeyError:
    failed = True
assert failed
tests.hint: os.environ-style dict access; missing key raises KeyError.

tests.name: secrets redacted before logging
tests.code:
assert redact('token secret=abc123 ok') == 'token secret=[REDACTED] ok'
assert 'abc123' not in redact('secret=abc123')
